translation.name: Ri C'ac'a Trato ri Xuben ri Dios Quiq'uin ri Vinek

book.name: COLOSENSES
book.title: Ri carta ri xutz'ibaj ri apáostol San Pablo chique ri kach'alal ri ec'o pa Colosas

content: Rix patráon,
can xe c'a ri utz y ri choj tibana' quiq'uin ri isamajela', roma toka' chi'ic'u'x chi rix chuka' c'o jun Ivajaf chila' chicaj.
Can benek c'a ruvech tibana' orar,
y q'ues ta ri inojibal tok niben orar. Can jantape' c'a tic'oje' matioxinic iviq'uin.
Y tibana' orar koma roj chuka',
chi ri Dios nujek ta jun puerta
más chikavech richin chi nikatzijoj ri c'a juba' tuk'alajirisaj,
chi roma ri Cristo tok yojcolotej. Y chutzijoxic c'a ri' tok xinoc re pa cárcel.
Tic'utuj c'a chire ri Dios chi can jebel ta rubixic ninben tok xtintzijoj ri xuk'alajirisaj ri Dios, can achi'el ta ri ruc'amon chi ninben.
Y rix tivetamaj c'a yixbiyin chiquicojol ri vinek ri man quiniman ta ri Cristo.
Can ta jebel ri niben y nibij chique ri vinek. Man tiya' k'ij chi choj nic'o ri tiempo.
Can ta ronojel ri nibij c'o ta rutzil. Can ta achi'el c'o atz'an
riq'uin ri ich'abel richin c'o ruqui'il.
Tibana' c'a queri', richin chi can xe ta c'a ri ruc'amon ri nibij chique conojel ri c'o niquic'utuj chive.
Ri ruq'uisibel tak ch'abel
Ri kach'alal Tíquico xterutzijoj c'a chive ri achique nubanon.
Rija' jun kach'alal ri janíla ninvajo' y can nuben-vi c'a ri rusamaj ri Ajaf benek-ruvech. Can vachibil vi c'a chupan ri samaj.
Y ja rija' ri nintek-el chila' iviq'uin richin nretamaj achique ibanon y richin nucukuba' ic'u'x.
Y riq'uin rija' nintek-el chuka' ri kach'alal Onáesimo,
ri elenek-pe chila' iviq'uin rix. Ri Onáesimo can cukul c'a ruc'u'x riq'uin ri Dios, y yalan ninvajo'. Re ca'i' kach'alal re' xtiquitzijoj c'a chive ronojel ri banatajinek vave'.
Ri kach'alal Aristarco,
ri c'o viq'uin vave' pa cárcel, nutek-el rutzil-ivech. Y que chuka' ri' ri kach'alal Marcos
nutek-el rutzil-ivech. Ja rija' ri ruch'itic'ajol ri kach'alal Bernabáe. Y xinbij yan c'a chive chi vi napon chila' iviq'uin, can utz ruc'ulic tibana'.
Chuka' nutek-el rutzil-ivech ri kach'alal Jesáus, ri nibix chuka' Justo chire. Re oxi' kach'alal re' e nuvinak israelitas y banon ri circuncisiáon chique.

Junan yojsamej quiq'uin richin chi e q'uiy ta ri yeniman richin ri Ajaf Jesáus y ye'oc ta pa rajavaren o pa ruk'a' ri Dios. Man jun chic chique ri nuvinak ri nisamej ta viq'uin, xaxe rije', y janíla niquicukuba' nuc'u'x.
Ri kach'alal Epafras

nutek-el rutzil-ivech. Y rix jebel ivetaman ruvech rija' roma chila' iviq'uin rix petenek-vi, y jun utzilej rusamajel ri Cristo. Rija' riq'uin ronojel ránima nuben orar ivoma. Can jantape' c'a nuc'utuj chire ri Dios chi rix can xticuker ta ic'u'x riq'uin ri Dios,
chi can ta xtitz'aket ri ic'aslen y can ta xtiben ronojel ri nrajo' ri Dios chi niben.
Yin nintz'et c'a chi ri kach'alal Epafras yalan yixruc'uxla'aj, roma ri nuben ivoma rix y coma chuka' ri kach'alal ri ec'o pa tinamit Laodicea
y ri ec'o pa tinamit Hierápolis.
Y chuka' ri kach'alal Lucas nutek-el rutzil-ivech. Rija' jun c'a ak'omanel y yin janíla ninvajo'. Ri kach'alal Demas nutek chuka' el rutzil-ivech.
Y rix tibana' utzil tiya' rutzil-quivech ri kach'alal ri ec'o pa tinamit Laodicea. Y tiya' rutzil-ruvech ri kach'alal Ninfas y conojel ri kach'alal ri niquimol-qui'
pa rachoch rija' richin niquiya' ruk'ij ri Dios.

Y tok rix isiq'uin chic re carta re' chiquivech ri kach'alal, can tibana' c'a chi tisiq'uix chuka' chiquivech ri kach'alal ri ec'o pa tinamit Laodicea. Y que chuka' ri' ri jun chic carta ri ninben-el chique rije', ninvajo' chi rix nisiq'uij
chuka'.
Y tibana' c'a utzil tibij chire ri kach'alal Arquipo
chi yin janíla yiquicot riq'uin, roma rija' nuben ri samaj
ri yo'on chire roma ri Ajaf, y man tutanaba' c'a rubanic ri samaj ri'.
Yin Pablo nintek c'a el rutzil-ivech. Y titz'eta' c'a re ruq'uisibel parte chire re carta re', can riq'uin c'a nuk'a' yin xinben-vi-el. Y man timestaj chi inc'o pa cárcel.
Ri rutzil ri Dios xtic'oje' ta c'a iviq'uin chi'ivonojel. Que ta c'a ri'.
